title: How to read your HPCL (HP Lubes) invoice
subtitle: Lube warehouse invoice. Quantity is already in pieces (EA).

footer.label: Tax columns
footer.value: CGST + SGST, or one IGST column

steps.text: Quantity: type Quantity (EA) and keep Pieces. EA is already bottles/cans, so no conversion.
Amount: type Total Value. A line with 0.00 is free stock: type the quantity and leave the amount 0.
Discount: type Disc. if it is not 0.
Printed total: type the Net Amount total. You can close the invoice only when it matches.
Tax type: if the invoice has one IGST column (e.g. shipped from the Bengaluru warehouse), choose IGST. If it has CGST and SGST columns, keep CGST + SGST.

hints.tax_type: HPCL: IGST if the invoice shows one IGST column
